evals.prompt: Write one cold email to founders of product brands that want more retail stockists. Sender: Get Wholesale Orders (https://getwholesaleorders.com). Confirmed services: retail-buyer outreach by email and LinkedIn with meetings booked into the brand's calendar; Faire and RangeMe storefront management; private B2B ordering portal with pricing tiers, minimums and net terms. CTA: free wholesale audit (self-serve, about 4 minutes, emails a score out of 100 and a 90-day plan as a PDF). No customer results, testimonials or personal sender name. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: One service-led email: fresh opening about the reader's retail goal, at most two services in plain verbs, one ask offering the audit as described on its own page (score + 90-day plan, not an in-person review). Full tags and footer. No proof, no save, no send.
assertions: Opening is about the reader, written fresh, not copied from writing.md or humanizer.md examples
Names at most two services
Audit is described accurately as a self-serve score and 90-day plan
Exactly one CTA, phrased as an easy question
Hi [FNAME], recipient [COMPANYNAME] where natural, and footer: Best, [Your Name], Get Wholesale Orders, https://getwholesaleorders.com, [Unsubscribe]([UNSUBSCRIBE_URL])
No humanizer tells and no em or en dashes
Nothing invented about results, customers or the recipient

evals.prompt: Write a 4-email sequence (days 0, 3, 7, 14) for Get Wholesale Orders (https://getwholesaleorders.com). Confirmed services: retail-buyer outreach by email and LinkedIn with meetings booked into the brand's calendar; Faire and RangeMe storefront management; private B2B ordering portal with pricing tiers, minimums and net terms. CTA: free wholesale audit (self-serve, about 4 minutes, emails a score out of 100 and a 90-day plan as a PDF). No customer results, testimonials or personal sender name. Audience: product-brand founders. Draft only. The homepage also shows a blog teaser saying wholesale orders range from $150 on Faire to $2,500+ via reps; that article was not opened.
evals.expected_output: Four standalone steps. Email 1 has at most two services; each follow-up adds one held-back service or fact, is 40-80 words, varies its shape and words the audit ask differently. Faire facts are conditioned ('if you sell on Faire'). The unread teaser figure is not used. Last step is an honest close. Full tags and footer on every step.
assertions: Every step names the sender and describes the audit in one clause
Each follow-up introduces exactly one new service or fact
Follow-ups are 40-80 words and do not share one paragraph template
Audit ask is worded differently in each step
Does not assume the recipient sells on Faire
Does not use the unread $150 / $2,500 figures
Full tags and linked footer on every step

evals.prompt: Write a cold email to finance managers at 50-500 person companies. Brand: Tallybook, an expense tool that flags reports with missing receipts as soon as they are submitted. CTA: reply for a two-minute walkthrough video. No proof. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: Short (50-80 words) email built on the one confirmed capability, segment-level relevance, one reply CTA. No invented time savings or customers.
assertions: Uses only the confirmed capability
No invented percentages, hours saved or customer names
Single reply-based CTA for the walkthrough
Footer uses Tallybook identity with [Your Website] since no site was given

evals.prompt:
Rewrite this draft, it sounds like AI. Keep the offer and the free audit CTA. 'Subject: Unlock Your Wholesale Potential

Hi [FNAME],

I hope this email finds you well! Quick question — are you looking to take [COMPANYNAME] to the next level in retail?

At Get Wholesale Orders, we're not just an agency — we're your end-to-end wholesale partner. We help brands connect with retail buyers, streamline sales outreach, and seamlessly manage Faire, RangeMe, and B2B ordering, so you can focus on what you do best.

Would you be open to a quick chat to explore how we can help?' Website https://getwholesaleorders.com. Draft only.
evals.expected_output: One rewritten email, not a list of tells. Same offer and audit CTA (no switch to a call). Every listed tell is gone. Full footer added.
assertions: Returns one final email without showing the marked-up pass
Removes: canned opener, dashes, not-X-but-Y, 'next level', 'end-to-end', 'streamline', 'seamlessly', the triad, 'focus on what you do best', 'quick chat to explore'
Keeps the audit as the CTA
Adds the full linked footer
Does not save any preference
